featured_reviews.name: josten dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently used Super Luxury Car Rental for our wedding, and the entire experience was nothing short of spectacular. We booked a white Mercedes C-Class, and every step, from initial inquiry to drop-off, was seamless.
The booking process was super smooth and efficient, making the pre-wedding planning much easier. On the day, the car arrived exactly on time. The Mercedes itself was absolutely neat and clean, presenting beautifully for the occasion.
What truly set the service apart was the attention to detail. The red rose decoration was superb, adding the perfect touch of elegance and romance to the vehicle. Our chauffeur, Pramod, was incredibly professional, courteous, and handled the journey with great care and precision. He ensured we were comfortable and kept the schedule perfectly.
Overall, it was a great experience and added a wonderful element of luxury and ease to our special day. I wholeheartedly recommend Super Luxury Car Rental and especially Chauffeur Pramod to anyone looking for premium service. We would absolutely book with them again!

featured_reviews.name: Nahid Kamal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avinash was an excellent driver and the S-Class was the perfect choice for our Mumbai trip.

We were in Mumbai for a few days and had a packed schedule with lots of shopping and running around. The car was in great condition, clean, comfortable, and ideal for getting from place to place throughout the day. Avinash was always on time, consistently courteous, and ready to go, even with multiple stops and multiple stores every day.

What really stood out was how helpful he was beyond just driving. He gave great recommendations, helped us navigate where to go, and made sure we found exactly what we were looking for.

Highly recommended. We’ll definitely rent from here again.

featured_reviews.name: Muthukumar Thirujnan
featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Milan Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Rented the Maybach for daugther's wedding/reception events. Excellent car, very comfortable, clean, and smooth. Noise insulation is noticeable in traffic - quiet oasis in the middle of Mumbai traffic chaos. Driver Anil bhai was excellent - quiet (speaks only when spoken to), super courteous, safe and flawless driving, on time - even when  we had aggressive schedules starting from very early morning to very late night. Only heads up is that despite it's size, it doesn't hold much luggage - trunk won't hold 2 large suitcases and 2 carry-ons.
